programmes.d: A farmer whose credit has run out gets a loan from Marshal Dillon and Festus Haggen, then loses the money in a poker game.
A rainmaker tries to end Dodge City's drought before a public well, the town's last source of water, runs dry.
A Scandinavian immigrant and his teenage son find the West even wilder than they had imagined when they settle in Dodge City.
To Marshal Matt Dillon and his deputies falls their grimmest task in many years -- the hanging of a ruthless gunman.
Kitty's conscience is torn between her sense of obligation to a man who saved her life and her concern for the law and Matt Dillon.
After eight years as a debt-plagued dirt farmer, a reformed outlaw rejoins his old gang to rob the Dodge City freight office.
A Quaker colony tries to save the giant sequoias from a timber baron.
Private detectives use Kitty and the daughter of an outlaw as lures to trap the girl's fugitive father.
Five nuns bring a wounded outlaw into Dodge City, then are reluctant to turn him in because he saved their lives.
A lovesick, broke transient embarks on a lucrative but perilous career-boiling nitroglycerine off dynamite for a gang of robbers.
Matt Dillon hunts a gang that has shattered one safe after another with nitroglycerine.
Kitty helps Marshal Matt Dillon switch identities with a killer in order to escape when they are kidnapped by outlaws.
United States Marshal Matt Dillon of Dodge City must deal with fast trigger-happy outlaw Dan Grat (Paul Richards) who wants his way with the town.
Matt must defend a gunman he despises from townspeople who want to lynch him for a crime he didn't commit.
To save his own life, murder witness Doc gives his word of honor to the killers (including Claude Akins) that he won't expose them.
Matt tries to save the life of a man dying of gangrene.
A group of outlaws try to force an old prospector to give up his gold.
No one believes a boy's claims that he overheard an outlaw planning a robbery.
A landowner asks Matt to remove a couple from a home on part of his land, which the couple insists they bought and paid for, and which they refuse to vacate.
An ex-outlaw's attempt to hang up his gun proves difficult.
A legendary buffalo hunter invites the wrath of Indians when he sets out to cross their sacred hunting grounds.
Two men try to force a Chinese man out of Dodge.
Parsley Smith, a teller of tall tales, claims the new town banker is plotting to make off with the depositors' money.

It's Christmas in Dodge and Chester isn't pleased when his brother Magnus arrives for a visit (Robert Easton appears). One of very few times a radio episode was adapted to TV with the same guest actor playing the role in both media.
A beautiful young wife (Lola Albright) manipulates a young hired hand into killing her older husband.
A peddler's miracle curative contains opium and proves fatal.
A man who claims he's innocent of a murder in a corrupt town breaks out of Matt's jail, and his trail leads Matt to the corrupt sheriff (Mort Mills appears).
A woman offers a $1,000 reward to the man who kills Matt Dillon.
Witnesses are refusing to testify against an infamous outlaw.
Matt saves the life of a white boy raised by Indians who was shot trying to retrieve horses stolen from his tribe.
An ex-lawman and old friend of Matt's arrives in Dodge with failing eyesight, and a man who wants to kill him.
A well-liked hardware drummer is actually a man wanted for multiple murders.
Matt attempts to reform a young troublemaker (including James Nusser in a role other than Louie Pheeters).
